claim: Across the 30 benchmark datasets, the released-loader reproduction's mean COPOD ROC AUC was lower than the published mean recorded in the project's comparison table.
With the correct labels used in both conditions, correcting feature selection did not increase mean AP on every one of the four affected ARFF datasets.
The Wine, WBC and Satimage-2 diagnostics recovered the saved project averages, but did not establish the cause of the remaining differences from the recorded paper results.
On the full APS primary test set, Isolation Forest's mean AP across its five planned seeds exceeded the AP of both COPOD scoring procedures.
Removing the eight additional high-missingness APS features reduced the observed mean AP for each of the three evaluated methods relative to the primary condition.
In the synthetic extension, both COPOD procedures' ten-seed mean AP increased across the tested single-feature shift levels 0, 2, 4 and 6.
In the synthetic extension's correlation-0.8 dependence setting, Ledoit-Wolf exceeded fixed-reference COPOD on both ROC AUC and AP in every one of the ten planned data seeds.
In each of the synthetic extension's two null controls, the label-1 and label-0 groups follow the same population distribution by construction.
In the synthetic extension's correlation-0.8 dependence setting, fixed-reference COPOD achieved a ten-seed mean AP of approximately 0.5000.
The synthetic extension establishes Ledoit-Wolf as the best detector for future Scania APS observations.
